name: A-OKVQA
description: A-OKVQA is a crowdsourced visual question answering dataset with about 25K questions that require commonsense and world knowledge to answer. Unlike prior VQA datasets, it demands reasoning beyond simple knowledge base queries, combining visual and natural language inputs for complex question answering.
reputation: A widely used multimodal VQA benchmark for commonsense and world-knowledge reasoning, commonly cited in vision-language research.
notes: Requires commonsense reasoning about scenes; questions cannot be answered by simple knowledge base queries.
